title: 職業指導
subtitle: Career Guidance
educationalGoal: Now in the situation of education, vocational guidance (career guidance) is changing to foster in students a zest for life. In this course, we understand the history of vocational guidance, the current situation around the school, and the trends in educational reformation. Then we will consider how students will select and determine their own way of life, and the way of vocational guidance (career guidance) that allows them to achieve self-actualization.
advice: This course is divided into two parts as below. Part 1: historical and theoretical considerations 1. The change of society and the current situation around students 2. The history of vocational guidance(career guidance) 3. Curriculum and vocational guidance(career guidance) 4. The basic theory of vocational guidance 5. The current situation of vocational guidance(career guidance) Part 2: Practical consideration 1. The concept and practice of vocational guidance(career guidance) 2. The educational evaluation of vocational guidance(career guidance) 3. The collaborative design of vocational guidance(career guidance) 4. Exercise: making an annual guidance plan
requiredKnowledge: To be interested in the current situation of education and school.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain curriculum and vocational guidance(career guidance).
Be able to explain the significance of vocational guidance(career guidance).
Be able to make an annual plan for vocational guidance based on the theory of vocational guidance.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.
